column1: # The product map of the advisory index: which NVD product (CPE vendor:product)
# each product name azhaq reports is. One product a line, three tab-separated
# columns: the name as azhaq reports it (a banner, a Server header, a
# technology name of the wappalyzer or cpedetect catalogue), the NVD
# vendor:product, and where the name comes from:
#   service     a product azhaq names on the wire (internal/portscan)
#   hand        a product of azhaq's catalogues (or another spelling of one), mapped by
#   wappalyzer  the CPE of a fingerprint of internal/wappalyzer
#   cpedetect   the vendor and product of a query of internal/cpedetect
# A name reaches the products of its best source only (service, hand, then
# wappalyzer, then cpedetect), so a catalogue guess never adds to a line
# written by hand. Several lines for one name are the several names NVD
# has used for one product (nginx:nginx and f5:nginx).
# Left out on purpose, because the version azhaq reads is not a release of
# that product: Microsoft IIS and HTTPAPI (the version is the Windows level),
# Apache-Coyote (the connector's version, not Tomcat's), operating systems
# and firmware (a banner names no patch level), hosted services and the
# Office document generators wappalyzer names. `go run ./scripts/advindex
# -unmapped FILE` lists the catalogue products this table has no line for.
# The wappalyzer and cpedetect lines were drafted by `go run ./scripts/advindex
# -draft-map FILE` from those catalogues' own vendor and product fields, then
# kept only where NVD has the product as an application and reviewed for
# operating systems, hosted services and the generic names.
Adobe Experience Manager Edge Delivery Services
